name: Claude Code
author: Tulpar Control
description: Shows Claude Code at work on the light bar: a sweep while it works, its task list filling the bar as tasks get done, a pulse when it needs you, and a flash when it's finished. Press Connect Claude Code once to add its hooks.

settings.label: Show task progress
settings.description: When Claude keeps a task list, the bar fills as the tasks get done.

settings.label: Needs you
settings.description: Claude asks for permission or waits for an answer.
